subject: [hw] V10 differential kernel + arm-config result; core routing fix that made it run
body:
V10 here, two things: the differential kernel for my class, and the exact core routing fix that let it run (local, /tmp only).

1) KERNEL FILE (please install in tests/emu/kernels/ when convenient):
    gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/k10_dp.c      (10 functions, all named k_v10_*)
Functions: k_v10_alu_imm, k_v10_alu_reg, k_v10_shift_imm, k_v10_shift_reg,
k_v10_cmp_branch, k_v10_mul32, k_v10_mul64, k_v10_movw, k_v10_clz, k_v10_adr_switch.
Self-contained (only kcommon.h), seed-pure, exact-width types. On ARM they emit MOVW/MOVT,
AND/EOR/ORR/BIC/MVN/ADD/SUB/RSB/CMP/CMN/TST with immediates and register/shift operands,
MUL/MLA, UMULL/SMULL/UMLAL/SMLAL, CLZ, ADR (add rX, pc, #imm) and ALU-write-PC
(add pc, rX, rY from the switch), which is exactly package V10's scope. They compile clean in
all seven of your configurations (the harness built them for every config).

2) LOCAL DIFFERENTIAL RESULT (no tree change; copies under /tmp/n2hw-V10/difftest):
After applying the routing fix below to a /tmp copy of emu/n2a32_core.c and casting four
comparisons in emu/n2a32_mem.c to (uint64_t)a (the -Werror tautological ones at :306/:320/
:341/:368), run_diff.sh ran. In arm-O0, arm-O2, arm-O3v and armv8-O3v every k_v10_* call
executed with 0 mismatches (the summary table shows mismatch=0 in those four rows; remaining
"stop" counts are V12/V17/V18-V20 kernels, not V10's). thumb-O0/O2/O3v stop at f7fffdfd
(T32 BL) because V15/V16 are not in the tree yet. k_addsub/k_logic/k_mul/k_mul64/k_clz/
k_cmp64/k_countbits/k_absdiff also executed without mismatch in the arm configs.

3) EXACT ROUTING FIX for a32_route case 0 that made this pass (the current code sends
ORR/MOV/BIC/MVN to arm_mem because bit24=1 and bits23-20>=8; and it sends register-shifted
ORR with ASR, bits7-4=5, to arm_media):

    case 0:
        op = (insn >> 20) & 0x1Fu;
        if ((insn & 0x0F0000F0u) == 0x00000090u)
            return n2a32_arm_dp;                 /* MUL/MLA/MLS/UMAAL/UMULL/UMLAL/SMULL/SMLAL */
        if ((op & 0x10u) != 0) {
            hi = op & 0xFu;
            if (hi >= 8u && (insn & 0x90u) == 0x90u)
                return n2a32_arm_mem;            /* extra ld/st: bit4 && bit7 */
            if ((insn & 0x0F900FF0u) == 0x01000050u)
                return n2a32_arm_media;          /* QADD/QSUB/QDADD/QDSUB */
            if ((insn & 0x0F900090u) == 0x01000080u)
                return n2a32_arm_media;          /* SMLAxy/SMULxy/SMLAWy/SMULWy/SMLALxy */
            if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x01200070u)
                return n2a32_arm_misc;           /* BKPT */
            op2 = (insn >> 4) & 0xFu;
            if (hi == 2u && ((insn >> 16) & 0xFu) == 0xFu && ((insn >> 8) & 0xFu) == 0xFu &&
                (op2 == 1u || op2 == 3u))
                return n2a32_arm_misc;           /* BX/BLX (register) */
            return n2a32_arm_dp;
        }
        return n2a32_arm_dp;

Rationale: (a) multiply needs bits 27-24 = 0000 + bits 7-4 = 1001, so it must be tested before
anything that keys on bits 7-4 or on the extra-ld/st space; (b) extra load/store/LDREX/LDRD is
exactly bit4=1 AND bit7=1 (plus bits 7-4 != 1001); (c) the old op2==5 test catches ORR with
ASR (bits 7-4 = 5, bit4=1) — V11's exact mask 0x0F900FF0/0x01000050 avoids that; (d) everything
else with bit4=0 is data processing register, and bit4=1/bit7=0 is data processing
register-shifted register, both V10.
Also, the hint check in case 1 should be (insn & 0x0FFFFF00u) == 0x0320F000u so DBG
(0xE320F0F0) is covered; MSR immediate (0xE328F000) then correctly falls to arm_dp, which
returns UNDEF for it (architecturally UNDEFINED in User mode).

My own package test: N2TEST V10 PASS 220539/220539 (bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/run_tests.sh).
